data.name: Eilaana
data.gender_notes: Eilaana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Il', meaning 'prosperity' and 'Ana', meaning 'goddess'. Eilaana is the name of a Hindu goddess revered for her blessings of wealth, success, and abundance. The name Eilaana carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eilaana usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eilaana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eilaana total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
